method: Unmodified rig.ts executed by native Node TypeScript import; unmodified Figure transpiled in memory and rendered with ReactDOMServer.

coordinateSystem.units: abstract figure units, not metres or pixels
coordinateSystem.svgMapping: svgX = origin.x + x; svgY = origin.y - y
coordinateSystem.rotation: degrees counterclockwise from +x about shape center before SVG y flip
coordinateSystem.depth: 2D drawing order only; no physical depth supplied

shapeSchema.w: line stroke width or box width
shapeSchema.r: disc radius or box corner radius
shapeSchema.rot: box rotation in degrees; omitted means 0
shapeSchema.halo: cut expanded silhouette out of all EARLIER body layers only
shapeSchema.furn: line uses furniture minimum width rule
shapeSchema.layer: -1 ground, 0+ body layers back to front
shapeSchema.id: optional diagnostic limb name; not a unique bone ID

renderer.mask: white keeps; black expanded cutters remove; ground bypasses every mask

frameSequences.note: 12 equal geometry steps, not equal playback-time samples; outbound only

stand.name: Stand
stand.source: rig.ts; descriptive pose label, not an exercise menu name

tall.name: Tall
tall.source: rig.ts; descriptive pose label, not an exercise menu name

victory.name: Victory
victory.source: rig.ts; descriptive pose label, not an exercise menu name

cheer.name: Cheer
cheer.source: rig.ts; descriptive pose label, not an exercise menu name

icon.name: Overhead press (icon)
icon.note: Static icon composition, not a rig move. Body and arms share first layer (no halo cutters); bar and plates second. Line widths already include icon bolding.
